Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch joins CNBC's Arjun Kharpal to discuss the next phase of the AI revolution, from the race to build data centers and secure computing power to the growing importance of sovereignty.

Mensch explains why he believes Mistral's business is about turning "electrons into tokens" — the units of text generated and processed by AI models — and why access to compute, GPUs and token generation is becoming a strategic issue for businesses and governments.

He also discusses Mistral's push into enterprise AI agents, the cybersecurity challenges that come with greater automation, and the possibility of developing custom chips in the future as the industry looks to reduce costs and improve performance.

The conversation also explores why the focus is shifting from abstract debates about AGI toward the practical work of deploying AI across businesses, industries and the physical world.

Mistral 首席执行官 Arthur Mensch 做客 CNBC，与 Arjun Kharpal 一道探讨人工智能革命的下一阶段——从竞相建设数据中心、确保算力供应，到主权问题日益凸显的重要性。

Mensch 阐述了他为何认为 Mistral 的业务本质是将“电子转化为 token”——即 AI 模型生成和处理的文本单位——以及为何算力、GPU 与 token 生成能力的获取正成为企业和政府的战略议题。

他还谈及 Mistral 向企业级 AI agent 的推进、自动化程度提升带来的网络安全挑战，以及未来开发定制芯片的可能性——因为整个行业都在寻求降低成本并提升性能。

对话还探讨了为何关注焦点正从有关 AGI 的抽象辩论，转向将 AI 部署到企业、各行各业以及物理世界中的实际工作。
